From: kimjo02@finearts.demean.edu
Dear Architecture Majors,
I am writing to inform you that the lecture by our visiting
professor, Dr. Roman Garcia, has been rescheduled. The talk
on sustainable architecture will now be on April 10 at 3 P.M. in
Grenden Hall, room 760.
Please adjust your schedules accordingly.
Regards,
John Kim
